items.title: Charlie Love Interview, 1960-01-16
items.q: The old bro. Because he's right in age with Pauli and Vincent.

ctx.x: This fellow was around here, I think. He's young. McNeil, bro. Huh?
McNeil, bro. He's here and Wellman, bro, is the old one. That's the one.
It must have been him. The old bro. Because he's right in age with Pauli and Vincent.
